scene: The funicular glides upward as glowing neon signs shrink below the glass.
beats: Inside lies a brass star-wheel dial. The carriage clunks to a halt at the Comet Watch Rooftop, and the doors slide open under the starry sky.
The ceiling glass tints purple to reveal glowing constellations. The funicular docks smoothly at Comet Watch Rooftop, parting its doors beside cheerful cocoa robots.
The robot wakes with a musical chime and hands you a punchcard comet schedule. Ding! The doors open onto the breezy Comet Watch Rooftop platform.
picture: Flat side view inside the tilted glass-walled funicular. On the far left sits an embroidered velvet pouch on a green velvet bench. The player stands centre with telescope slung. Up high, an ornate brass dial glows. On the far right, a tin conductor robot naps against the exit door.
shown: a mysterious embroidered velvet pouch sitting on an empty seat on the left
an ornate brass cabin dial glowing softly on the wall up high
a sleeping robot conductor wearing a pillbox cap on the far right

after.label: Step off at Comet Watch Rooftop
Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as the funicular climbs into the clouds, rattling softly over sleepy spires. At the terminus, you hop onto a bridge crawler that clanks straight toward the bustling, rotating Gear Bridge.
